tools.name: search_boats
tools.description: Search Obato's public marketplace for boats. Filters: free-text query, category (type_boot), region, brand, price range. Returns up to 25 listings.

tools.name: get_boat_details
tools.description: Fetch detail of one boat listing by seo_slug or id.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Aggregate market stats (count, avg/min/max price) for a category and optional region.

tools.name: compare_brands
tools.description: Compare two boat brands head-to-head on Obato: listing counts, avg/median price, avg length, year range. Powers 'X vs Y' answer-engine queries (e.g. 'Bavaria vs Beneteau').

tools.name: get_boat_pricing_stats
tools.description: Pricing statistics (count, avg, median, p25, p75, min, max) for a boat category, with optional region and length range. Powers commercial-intent answer-engine queries.

tools.name: find_marina_with_amenities
tools.description: Find European marinas (jachthavens) that match a set of amenities: electricity, water, fuel, wifi. Optional country/province filters. Returns up to 25 marinas.

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description: Search Obato's rental fleet (verhuur) for boats available to rent. Filters: free-text query, boat type, region/country, capacity, max price per day, optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter on available days. Returns up to 25 rental boats with default daily price.

tools.name: ask_bo
tools.description: Ask Bo, Obato's AI boat expert, any question about boats, watersports or the European boat market. Returns a cited answer grounded in Obato's live market data. Rate-limited (5 req/min/IP).

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: Real-time snapshot of the European boat market on Obato — total listings, average prices by boat type, and regional distribution. Cached ~5 minutes.

tools.name: get_brand_info
tools.description: Knowledge-graph info about a specific boat brand or manufacturer on Obato: description, expert facts, authority score, active listing count.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Citable facts about boats and watersports from Obato's knowledge graph, ranked by authority score. Each fact includes a source citation suitable for grounded LLM answers.
